name: smwpatches-dry-bones-and-bony-beetle-reanimation-sfx
title: Dry Bones and Bony Beetle Reanimation SFX
description:
This patch adds in additional sound effects when Dry Bones and Bony Beetle is about to reanimate itself, similarly to the NSMB games.

Comes with two custom sound effects as well instructions on how to insert them.

While not strictly required for this patch to work, it's meant to be used in conjunction with Dry Bones and Bony Beetle SubOffScreen Fix so the sound effects don't play when said sprites are off-screen.
